title: Operation Manager
description:
Graduate or Diploma holder in Hotel Management or Hospitality Management

Preferred Candidate Profile 

Minimum 58 years of experience in hotel or resort operations,preferably with experience in a managerial or senior supervisory role

Experience handling resort operations,banquets,destination weddings,corporate MICE,leisure groups,and student groups will be preferred

Key Skills: Beverage,Strong interpersonal skills,Hotel management,Communication skills,Management,Leadership skills,Team management,Interpersonal Skill

title: Food And Beverage Manager
description:
Graduate or Diploma holder in Hotel Management,Hospitality Management,or a related field

Preferred Candidate Profile 

Minimum 4-7 years of experience in Food & Beverage operations,preferably with experience as an F&B Manager or Assistant F&B Manager

Experience in resorts,luxury hotels,banquet operations,destination weddings,and large group dining will be preferred

Key Skills: Beverage,Liquor,Banquet Operations,Restaurant management,Management,Handling,Leadership skills,Banquets
